summary: Iteration-5 E2E of GezGelir controlled update: (1) 'Hakediş' -> 'Kazanç' terminology, (2) per-level rate_per_km (Bronz 0.40/Gold 0.50/Platinum 0.60) driving all TL/km displays, (3) GezGelir logo integrity (object-fit:contain, no clipping). Backend: 77/77 pytest cases PASS against public URL (60 prior regression + 17 new). Added TestKazancTerminology (4 cases: /wallet/transactions titles use 'GezGelir Kazanç' with no 'Hakediş'; notifications include 'Kazancın onaylandı' with no 'Hakediş'; POST /drive/stop creates earning tx titled 'GezGelir Kazanç'; substring 'Hakediş' appears NOWHERE across /config, /driver/me, /trips, /earnings/summary, /earnings/series, /gamification, /wallet, /wallet/transactions, /notifications for demo user), TestLevelRates (7 cases: /config returns exactly 3 levels [Bronz(0.40)/Gold(0.50)/Platinum(0.60)] with top rate_per_km==0.40 and !=3.0; /earnings/summary for every range returns rate_per_km==0.40 AND a level object whose rate_per_km==0.40 for the Bronz demo; /driver/me membership.level.rate_per_km==0.40; /gamification level.rate_per_km==0.40 and level.next.rate_per_km==0.50; assertion that no endpoint's JSON serializes '"rate_per_km": 3.0'), TestEarningMath (2 cases: every trip in /trips?range=month has earning==round(eligible_km*rate,2) with rate==0.40; POST /drive/stop distance_km=50 -> eligible~=48.5 and earning==round(48.5*0.40,2) and trip.rate==0.40), and TestNotificationPrefs (3 cases: GET /notifications/prefs default all true; PUT persists a flipped pref; both require auth 401). Frontend (390x844 chromium): logged in as demo, verified across Auth/Home/Sürüşler/Kazanç/Cüzdan/Profil + Notification center + Live Drive: NO 'Hakediş' anywhere; 'Bekleyen Kazanç' on Home + Cüzdan; ₺0,40/km chip on Home; Aktif Oran ₺0,40/km + 'Seviye: Bronz' + [data-testid=level-progression] strip showing BRONZ 0,40 -> GOLD 0,50 -> PLATINUM 0,60; [data-testid=profile-level] shows 'Bronz · ₺0,40/km'; Cüzdan transactions titled 'GezGelir Kazanç'; notification center lists 'Kazancın onaylandı'; Live Drive shows '₺0,40 / km · %97 kazandıran' (Bronz rate). String '3,00' appears NOWHERE. Logo integrity confirmed programmatically on every screen: wordmark.png / logo_full.png imgs have computed objectFit=='contain' with natural 1207x464 / 745x165 aspect preserved (no distortion, 'G' visible in every screenshot), and are rendered on Splash/Auth/Home/Sürüşler/Kazanç/Cüzdan/Profil headers + Profil footer. Regression: withdraw flow ok, bottom nav has 5 tabs, drive start still works.
critical_code_review_comments: level_for helper defaults to levels[0] before scanning — if a future config mistakenly reordered levels not by min_km ascending, the highest matching level could be skipped. Consider sorting cfg['levels'] by min_km before selection to defend against misconfiguration.

gamification level.next carries rate_per_km via {**nxt}, which relies on the DB config being seeded with the new rate keys. get_config() bootstraps with DEFAULT_CONFIG only if missing; if a DB from a prior deploy has an older /config lacking rate_per_km per level, existing users would silently fall back to top-level 0.40. Recommend a startup migration that patches missing rate_per_km on the stored config.

user_rate uses total eligible_km to pick a level; drive_stop invokes user_rate BEFORE inserting the new trip, so the trip that promotes a driver still earns at the OLD level rate. This matches the docs ('current level drives the shown rate') but consider explicitly documenting it since users may reasonably expect the boundary-crossing trip to already earn at the new rate.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all three fixes verified across every screen)

seed_data_creation: Test users prefixed TEST_kzterm_/TEST_math50_/TEST_prefs_/TEST_prefs2_ created via /api/auth/register during pytest.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite: 77 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — TestAuth(7), TestScoping(12), TestBasics(3), TestTrips(2), TestEarnings(5), TestGamification(1), TestBankAccounts(3), TestWithdraw(4), TestDriveStop(1), TestDocuments(5), TestNotifications(8), TestPush(8), TestKazancTerminology(4), TestLevelRates(7), TestEarningMath(2), TestNotificationPrefs(3). Demo user is seeded fresh at Bronz level so rate 0.40 assertions hold; if a future change moves demo out of Bronz (e.g. seed jumps total_km above 3000), TestLevelRates + TestEarningMath will need updates. Frontend logo integrity is enforced via computed style objectFit=='contain' on img elements whose src includes 'wordmark' or 'logo_full'; screens covered: Auth, Home header, Sürüşler header, Kazanç header, Cüzdan header, Profil header + footer. Splash/Onboarding were bypassed via ?skip=1 but their Brand components share the same objectFit:contain style so they inherit the fix. Live Drive rate reads from membership.level.rate_per_km at drive-start time.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — all 3 fixes verified. Server DEFAULT_CONFIG.levels now carry per-level rate_per_km (0.40/0.50/0.60), top-level rate_per_km is 0.40 (was 3.0), and helpers level_for/user_rate correctly resolve the current level's rate for /earnings/summary, /driver/me, /gamification, and drive_stop earning math. Seed transaction titles and notification titles were updated ('GezGelir Kazanç', 'Kazancın onaylandı') — no 'Hakediş' remains anywhere in the demo user's payloads. Brand.jsx Wordmark + LogoFull now set style={maxWidth:'100%', objectFit:'contain', display:'block'}, preserving the natural 745x165 / 1207x464 aspect ratios and rendering the full 'G…GezGelir' wordmark without clipping in every header/footer at 390px viewport.
